query:
SELECT mr.*, m.name as molecule_name, r.name as recette_name 
FROM molecules_recettes mr 
JOIN molecules m ON mr.molecule_id = m.id 
JOIN recettes r ON mr.recette_id = r.id 
WHERE m.name LIKE '%Androst%'
